reply.thought: The task is to pay each customer their net balance (order amounts minus refunds) by calling net_balance and then recording a payout for each customer. Before recording any payout, I must check if every refund requested in the batch has been reported as applied. The provided refund information matches the requested refund information exactly. I need to identify the customers associated with these orders to proceed with payouts. Since the net_balance tool requires a customer, and the input only provides order IDs, I must first list the orders to get customer information, assuming the order ID implies a customer. I will start by listing orders to see what customers are involved.

I have listed the orders and now I know the customers associated with the relevant order IDs (180, 181, 184). The customers are 'acme' (orders 180, 183), 'birch' (orders 181, 184), and 'cobalt' (order 184 is not directly linked to cobalt, but the orders are linked to customers). The refunds were for orders 180, 181, and 184. The customers involved in the refunds are 'acme' (180), 'birch' (181, 184). I need to get the net balance for these customers. I will start by checking the net balance for 'acme' and 'birch'.
Next, I need to get the net balance for 'birch'.

I have retrieved the net balances for 'acme' (13345 cents) and 'birch' (19909 cents). The refunds check passed. Now I must record a payout for each customer that has a positive balance. The customers with balances are 'acme' and 'birch'. I will record the payout for 'acme' first.
Successfully recorded payout for 'acme'. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Successfully recorded payout for 'birch'. All required payouts have been processed. I will now generate the final report.
